name: 45232 · Cincinnati, OH
findings: ZIP 45232 (Cincinnati) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45232 (Cincinnati) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45232 (Cincinnati) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
